title: Packing density of Gerver's sofa
plain: Find the densest way to pack copies of Gerver's sofa shape in the plane, and show the density is not a rational multiple of an algebraic number.
math: Let $\delta_G$ be the translative-and-rotational packing density of Gerver's sofa. Prove $\delta_G\notin\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$.
